## Outcome

I built a more precise replacement for the original legend opt-out behavior.

## Context

PR #292 had delivered the first opt-out in Week 1, but it disabled too much. Issue #333 clarified the needed distinction between explicit selection chosen by a user and selection variables injected automatically from an interactive legend.

## What I Did

- Worked from [Issue #333](https://github.com/animint/animint2/issues/333) and opened [PR #336](https://github.com/animint/animint2/pull/336).
- Added a failing WorldBank test where a layer keeps `showSelected = "year"`, color uses `region`, and `showSelected.legend = FALSE` prevents `region` from being appended.
- Implemented the new parameter in the compiler path.
- Removed the temporary compiler parameter before visualization data is exported.
- Began retiring the earlier `showSelected = character()` special case so the API would have one clear opt-out path.
- Continued reviewer-driven cleanup in PR #286.

## Learnings

Explicit selection and legend-driven injection are separate behaviors. The new argument controls only the second and leaves the first untouched. I also learned that compiler-only parameters should influence compilation and then disappear rather than leak into generated visualization data.

## Challenges / Notes

Because `showSelected.legend` begins with `showSelected`, R partial matching could make `extra_params$showSelected` read the wrong parameter. Later regression tests explicitly guarded this boundary.

## Next Week Targets

Stabilize browser CI and extend multiline behavior to facet-strip labels.

### WorldBank selection semantics

**Explicit behavior:** `showSelected = "year"` remains active.

**Legend behavior:** `showSelected.legend = FALSE` prevents `region` from being added automatically.

**Historical status:** Open and ready at the August 24 cutoff; merged August 25, 2026.
:::

::: {.animint-live-demo .animint-demo-week-2}
<iframe src="week2-showselected-legend-demo/index.html" title="Interactive WorldBank visualization demonstrating showSelected.legend false" loading="lazy"></iframe>
:::

Choose a year in the lower plot or a region in the legend. The scatterplot still filters explicitly by `year`, while the visible `region` legend is not injected into that layer's `showSelected` variables.

<details class="demo-code">
<summary>View the essential R code</summary>

```r
animint(
  scatter = ggplot() +
    geom_point(
      aes(fertility.rate, life.expectancy, colour = region, key = country),
      showSelected = "year",
      showSelected.legend = FALSE,
      clickSelects = "country",
      data = WorldBank
    ),
  timeline = ggplot() + make_tallrect(WorldBank, "year"),
  selector.types = list(year = "single")
)
```

</details>

This bundle is isolated from the cutoff demos and is never included in the August 24 merge total.
